basic_details.job_title: DMRL DRDO Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Defence Metallurgical Research Laboratory (DMRL DRDO) has announced 7 vacancies for Metal Extraction Professional, Metal Processing Professional, Non-Destructive Testing Professional, Furnace Maintenance Operator, Design of Components Professional, Web Application Developer and Legal Consultant posts on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply by email on or before 4 November 2026 by downloading the application format from Appendix-B of the notification, filling it up with required details and attaching all requisite supporting documents. Qualifications and pay levels vary by post as sp

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 21 days from the date of publication of Advertisement on the DRDO website (04-11-2026)

qualification.details: General Eligibility: Officers/Officials who have retired from Central/State Govts., PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, Govt. R&D Organizations possessing practical knowledge and experience in the relevant field with an unblemished service record. Age Limit: The maximum age limit for all categories of retired Govt. employees for applying will be 63 years as on the closing date of application. Post Code 2026/DMRL/370: BSc or Diploma in Metallurgy / Chemical Engineering (MSc in Chemistry or B.E./B.Tech. in Metallurgy / Chemical Engineering desirable) with at least 15 years of experience in extractive metallurgy. Post Code 2026/DMRL/371: Diploma in Metallurgy / Mechanical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech. desirable) with at least 10 years of experience in Melting and Casting of Metals and Alloys or Powder Metal Processing or Mechanical Deformation processes involving forging or rolling. Post Code 2026/DMRL/372: Diploma in Physics or Metallurgy (M.Sc. in Physics or B. Tech. in Metallurgy desirable) with 10 years of experience in NDT of engineering components. Post Code 2026/DMRL/373: Diploma in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering (B.E./B. Tech. desirable) with at least 10 years of experience in maintaining electrical furnaces (resistance/induction) / ovens / electrical equipment. Post Code 2026/DMRL/374: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or 15 years of experience in designing of components (Diploma in Tool Design or BE / BTech in Mechanical Engineering desirable). Post Code 2026/DMRL/375: Diploma in Computer Science Engineering / IT / or 10 years of experience in related areas (BE / BTech in Computer Science Engineering / MSc in Computer Science desirable) with minimum 5 years of experience in web application design and development. Post Code 2026/DMRL/376: At least 15 years of experience in handling legal (Court) matters, liasoning with Assistant Solicitor General and senior counsels, and administrative/secretarial work.

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a short-term contract basis initially for a period of one year, and extendable as per norms based on the approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the fixed remuneration?
faq.answer: Consultants are not entitled to Dearness Allowance, Transport Facility, Residential Accommodation, CGHS, or Medical reimbursement. However, a fixed monthly conveyance allowance of ₹3,000/- (up to pay level-11) or ₹5,000/- (for pay level-12) is provided, along with TA/DA for official domestic travel.

faq.question: Q3. Can retired employees from PSUs apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, retired officials from Central Government, State Government, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, and Government R&D Organizations who meet the eligibility criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all categories of retired government employees applying for the consultant positions is 63 years as on the closing date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What should be mentioned in the subject line of the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must send their application by email to [email protected] with the subject line “Application for Consultant-Post Code”.
